tools.name: apple_ads_get_report
tools.title: apple ads get report
tools.description: Read native Apple campaign, ad group, ad, keyword or search-term performance for explicit campaigns. Preserves spend currency, attribution metrics, timezone, native grand totals and pagination. Never sum ratios or assume a page is the entire account. Monthly/weekly/daily historical reports are supported subject to Apple retention. Omit granularity for period totals. Campaign reports accept up to 20 campaigns; other levels require exactly one campaign per call.

adAccountId.description: Apple Ads ad account ID from APPLE_ADS_AD_ACCOUNT_IDS. apple_ads_list_ad_accounts lists them.

items.description: Apple numeric ID, as a string.

campaignIds.description: Campaign IDs: up to 20 for campaigns; exactly one for adgroups, ads, keywords or searchterms.

level.description: Report level: campaigns, adgroups, ads, keywords or searchterms.

startDate.description: First date of the reporting period, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: Last date of the reporting period, in YYYY-MM-DD format, on or after startDate and no later than today.

timeZone.description: Report timezone: account timezone (ORTZ) or UTC.

granularity.description: Time breakdown of granularMetrics. Omit for totals over the whole period.

fields.description: Native metric names. Omit to retrieve all native metrics; Apple validates availability.

groupBy.description: Native demographic or geographic grouping dimensions.

offset.description: Zero-based number of rows to skip. Pass nextOffset from the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return, from 1 to 1000. Use offset for more.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: apple_ads_create_campaign
tools.title: apple ads create campaign
tools.description: Create an App Store search-results campaign in PAUSED state. Requires an eligible app, explicit currency, budget and countries. No delivery is enabled by creation. Preview by default. Ask the user to approve the exact account, target and parameters before confirm:true.

adAccountId.description: Apple Ads ad account ID from APPLE_ADS_AD_ACCOUNT_IDS. apple_ads_list_ad_accounts lists them.

amount.description: Positive decimal amount in major currency units, such as 1.50.

dailyBudget.description: Positive decimal amount and the ad account currency.

countries.description: Eligible target storefront country codes, such as FR.

confirm.description: False previews. True applies the approved change once. Do not blindly retry a write after a timeout.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: apple_ads_create_account
tools.title: apple ads create account
tools.description: Create an additional Apple ad account in the API user's organization. Requires a configured anchor account in that same organization and Apple account-creation permissions. Currency, timezone and billing are inherited; no app delegations or delivery are configured. Add the new ID to APPLE_ADS_AD_ACCOUNT_IDS and restart before using it. Preview by default. Ask the user to approve the exact account, target and parameters before confirm:true.

adAccountId.description: Apple Ads ad account ID from APPLE_ADS_AD_ACCOUNT_IDS. apple_ads_list_ad_accounts lists them.

name.description: Name of the new ad account, unique within the organization.

confirm.description: False previews. True applies the approved change once. Do not blindly retry a write after a timeout.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

amount.description: Positive decimal amount in major currency units, such as 1.50.

expectedSnapshot.description: Snapshot returned by the preview for this exact resource and requested change; required when confirming.

confirm.description: False previews. True applies the approved change once. Do not blindly retry a write after a timeout.
